strengths: Strongest editorial art direction: expressive typography, airy spacing and a memorable mirror cover.
The dark insight spread gives the surprising observation appropriate emotional weight.
Readable room notes and specific guess labels make the evidence feel personal.
weaknesses: The long mobile article lacks visible section navigation for returning to particular evidence.
Oversized stat headings compete with the actual results; the outlined lettering is delicate at phone scale.
The reversed Delivery card makes the player's actual result less immediately clear.
Flips and story-image saving are described or signposted, but their behavior is unverified. The app-download ending is not shown.
top_fixes: Add compact sticky section navigation with a clear current-section state.
Keep the player's result and pips visible when revealing the opposite end; reduce decorative stat-heading size.
Finish with a clear friend challenge followed by an island-game download panel, preserving the editorial styling.

strengths: Most distinctive narrative atmosphere, with a convincing transition from dark introspection to pastel openness.
Desktop mirror-and-copy compositions have cinematic presence.
The visible ending connects the friend challenge to the island-game download.
weaknesses: The opening repeats the archetype names while delaying useful evidence, especially on mobile.
White text over detailed imagery, muted secondary text and translucent panels create uneven contrast.
Unlabeled navigation dots provide little help when revisiting a specific finding.
Wiping fog, synchronized gem lighting and holding reversed text upright are described, not demonstrated; essential reading could become unnecessarily demanding.
The radar shape implies a quantitative profile without clearly explaining its scale or bipolar axes.
top_fixes: Shorten the opening and provide labeled jump navigation for evidence review.
Keep all essential copy readable without wiping, holding or animation; reserve those effects for optional embellishment.
Replace the ambiguous radar with six clearly labeled pip scales and strengthen contrast across glass panels.

strengths: Best fit for reviewing a completed reveal: visible section tabs, compact stats and explicit comparisons support revisiting.
The room map, pip scales and party slots connect the article naturally to a cozy personality game.
Trait provenance is visible on the revealed card, giving the personality claims an inspectable basis.
The calls summary communicates the score and individual outcomes efficiently.
weaknesses: Repeated rounded cards, pastel gradients and identical mascot artwork make the visual system feel more familiar than award-defining.
The horizontally overflowing mobile tabs and trait carousel reduce discoverability.
Unflipped trait cards spend substantial space on decoration while concealing the promised evidence.
The empty party slot makes the friend challenge thematic but less prominent as a primary action.
Drawers, card tilt, flips and map-pin behavior remain unverified; the required app-download ending is not shown.
top_fixes: Expose a short provenance sentence on every trait card and reduce repeated decorative space.
Make mobile navigation overflow unmistakable and provide accessible, clearly labeled controls for drawers and cards.
Create a distinct final conversion section with a prominent friend challenge and an illustrated island-game download.

build_reason: C provides the strongest phone-first review structure, while A supplies the most polished visual identity. B contributes atmosphere, but its proposed interaction demands are poorly suited to revisiting evidence. Static screenshots cannot establish interaction quality or conversion performance.
hybrid_recipe: Use C's navigation, pip-based character sheet, visible trait provenance, room map and party structure. Apply A's editorial typography, mirror imagery, generous spacing and dark insight spread. Borrow B's restrained night-to-morning color progression and explicit island-download ending. Keep every essential finding readable without flipping, wiping or holding.
